A smaller version of the _kickback spring_ was first deployed as a deterrent to keep crops safe from nuisance foragers like [moose](/Monsters.aspx?ID=1233). These larger versions often line walls or other defensive points, providing a final layer of protection before a large creature would breach such areas. The _kickback spring_ fires a compressed disk of rapidly expanding air at creatures, attempting to push them back and provide defenders a moment to regroup. 

**Aim** <actions string="Two Actions" /> 25 feet, minimum distance 50 feet 

**Load** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) 2 times, requires a successful DC 22 [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) check 

**Launch** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([air](/Traits.aspx?ID=527), [attack](/Traits.aspx?ID=540), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645), [range increment 60 feet](/Rules.aspx?ID=2195)) 6d8 bludgeoning, 15-foot cone, DC 22 Reflex. A creature that fails its Reflex save is [pushed](/Rules.aspx?ID=451) 25 feet away from the _kickback spring_ as air rapidly vents from the device. On a critical failure, a creature falls [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=88) after being pushed back.
